Deduct nothing only if no A/B is earned on the datum anywhere. Never deduct from M/DM or make the score negative. The selected criterion remains earned for every DM, dependency and www check; one datum costs at most one net mark. Eligible OD-6 follow-through overrides not-F.T. and c.a.o. restrictions, while correct working, named method exclusions and OD-1 still apply. No-solution exclusion means a misread removes a solution the canonical question has; a designed no-real-solution outcome remains eligible when its demand and difficulty are preserved. An A/B is on a datum when it lies in the datum's first-use part or a later part whose working uses the misread data, whether or not that criterion's own value changes. Eligibility is judged at first use for the connected question. Eligible follow-through never overrides MR09 (no F.T. into a supplied result) or OD-1 answer-only rules.
